name: Muzaree
summary: Men's leather footwear from Pakistan (Chelsea boots, suede and leather loafers), sold on muzaree.com with cash on delivery. No design system existed: this one is PROPOSED from the brand's real assets (the live store's logos and fonts, the theme's colours, and the best-performing Meta ads) and needs the owner's and the client's confirmation. Its main job is future ad creatives.

ownership.note: A client brand managed by the agency owner. Served only to the owner's tenant (BRANDS_OWNER_TENANT_ID).

approvers: Muzaree (client) for anything that changes how the brand looks
approval.rule: Everything here is proposed until the owner confirms it (and the client, for the logo, colours and type). Ads made with it still follow the Muzaree media-buying rules: the owner's yes on every new ad, true prices only.

sources.ref: https://muzaree.com (home page HTML and CDN files)
sources.note: Logo files Refined_MUZAREE_logo.png (header, light) and Muzaree_logo_wbg.png (gold, dark), downloaded unchanged; theme fonts --g-font-1 Jost (headings) and --g-font-2 Poppins (body).

Theme export of 5 Sep 2026: color_primary #222222, color_body_text #414141, color_secondary #C79A2B, header/footer #282828, buttons uppercase 12px 600 with 0.1em tracking and 40px radius. The live theme may differ.
The account's best-ever ads (Feb 2026; 'chalsea Sales Ad -3': 220 sales at PKR 601). Backdrop colours sampled from chalsea_Sales_Ad_-3.
Remakes with true prices: text gold rgb(205,166,92), cream rgb(238,232,222), Playfair Display; copy facts checked on muzaree.com 2026-10-09.
Footwear only; never advertise items under PKR 5,599 (below break-even); discounts must be the true ones.
Font files and OFL texts. Jost and Poppins subset to Latin as WOFF; Playfair Display shipped unmodified because it has a Reserved Font Name.

sources.ref: Proposed from the Feb 2026 winners and the round-2 remakes: backdrop colours sampled from the images, gold and cream from remake_chelsea.py, serif from the posters.
Proposed from the live store and the theme export: Jost, Poppins, #222222, #414141, #C79A2B, black pill buttons.
Rules proposed from the paid-media notes, the round-2 copy rules and the storefront blueprint (Websites/Muzaree-Shopify/deliverables/muzaree-storefront-transformation-blueprint.md).

scale.sample: Premium cow leather. Brown or matt black, sizes 39 to 44.

rules: Ads: one serif family (Playfair Display) for headline, price and facts, centred, generous letter spacing on the facts line.
Store: Jost for headings, Poppins for text. Body text 16px (the theme uses 14px; 16px is the proposed minimum).
Capitalised product headlines are the brand's habit ('Confidence Starts From The Shoes'); keep it for headlines only.
Ads: about 64px margins on a 1080px canvas, and air around the price.
Store: 8px steps; more space between sections than inside them.

shadows.use: A grounded shadow under shoes cut out onto a dark canvas.

layout.grid: Product grid: 2 columns mobile, 3 tablet, 4 desktop.
rules: Mobile first: one focused value proposition, one primary CTA and one secondary path on the first screen.
Size, availability, delivery promise, exchange summary and payment options sit near the buy button.
No fake scarcity: show stock only when the count is accurate.

files.name: Muzaree logo, black (with 'Timeless Elegance')
files.use: The store header on white, light layouts, packaging inserts.

files.name: Muzaree logo, gold (with 'Timeless Elegance')
files.use: Dark ads and the dark store header. Only 300px wide: ask the client for a larger gold master before using it bigger than that.

logo.clearSpace: Proposed: at least one third of the logo's height on every side.

minSize.note: Proposed: 140px wide on screen so 'TIMELESS ELEGANCE' stays readable; on a 1080px ad, 260-300px wide (the gold file's native width is 300px).

do: Use the two original files only: gold on dark, black on light.
Bottom-centre on ads, as in the winning posters, with clear space above it.
Keep the ring mark, the name and the tagline together and in proportion.
dont: Never retype 'Muzaree' in a font as the logo. (The February posters set the word in a serif; use the real logo file instead.)
Never recolour, stretch, outline or add effects; never separate the ring mark from the name without a client-approved mark.
Never put the black logo on dark or the gold logo on white.
Never enlarge the 300px gold file past its size.
logo.licence: Muzaree's trademark, downloaded unchanged from the live store's CDN on 2026-10-10 for the agency's work for Muzaree. Not for any other use.

imagery.style: Low-key studio product photography: the real shoes in pairs (brown beside matt black), on a dark textured floor against warm walnut wood, lit from the side so the leather shines, with small gold props (a lantern, a tray, the gold-marked box). The product fills the lower two-thirds; the upper third is quiet for the headline.
do: Real product photos only, in the shoe's true colour; show the pair, the sole and the leather texture.
Two colourways side by side when both are on sale.
Leave the top third calm and dark enough for cream and gold type.
Recompose for each format; never stretch a 4:5 into 9:16.
dont: No AI-generated shoes or details that differ from the real product.
No watches or replica-brand products in ads (footwear only).
No busy backgrounds, bright colours or white studio sweeps on ads.
No product photo that shows a colour, size or price not currently on the store.

icons.style: Simple line icons for the service promises (free delivery, cash on delivery, warranty), as on the live store; one stroke weight, in gold on dark or ink on white.
rules: Each icon sits beside its words; never an icon alone.
No '24/7' or 'money-back' icons unless the promise is confirmed (the blueprint flags both).
Lead with how the shoes make him look and feel, then the facts: material, colours, sizes, price, delivery, payment.
Price format: 'Rs. 5,999 (was Rs. 10,999)'. Only the true current price and the true discount (10,999 to 5,999 is 45%).
Name occasions that matter to the buyer: office, dinner, a wedding, a mehndi.
Roman Urdu versions are welcome for the same facts.
No false urgency ('limited time', 'selling fast', 'only a few left') unless the store shows it is true.
No promise that is not confirmed: 'easy exchange', '24/7 support', '100% money-back'.
Footwear only. Never advertise items priced under PKR 5,599 (they lose money after ad costs).
One brand name once: never 'Muzaree Muzaree'.

examples.say: Rs. 5,999 (was Rs. 10,999). Free delivery. Cash on delivery.
examples.avoid: Up to 70% OFF (when the biggest real discount is 57%)

examples.say: Premium cow leather Chelsea boots, sizes 39 to 44.

rules: Layout of the best-ever ads: serif headline centred at the top, one large gold price, one or two fact lines, the real shoes in the lower two-thirds, the gold logo bottom-centre.
One message and one price per ad. The price and any discount must match the live store on the day the ad goes live.
Link to the product page of the advertised shoe, never to /collections/bags.
Text stays inside the safe area of every placement; check the Ads Manager preview before asking for approval.
Let Meta's CTA button (Order Now / Shop Now) do the action; a drawn button is optional.
Every new ad needs the owner's yes on the summary; nothing launches on its own.
